About this product

The TP-Link TL-SG1218MPE is an 18-port Gigabit Easy Smart switch, featuring 16 802.3af/at PoE+ ports with a robust 250W total power budget and up to 30W per port. It includes two Gigabit SFP slots for fiber uplinks. This switch offers essential L2 management features such as VLAN, QoS, Link Aggregation, and IGMP Snooping, enabling optimized network performance and effective traffic management. Its durable metal casing ensures reliable operation for demanding SMB environments.
